newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: HongKong Bank NZ cuts 2-5 yr fixed mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: HongKong Bank NZ cuts 2-5 yr fixed mortgage rate.

text.p: Hongkong Bank New Zealand on Thursday said it had cut its 2-5 year fixed mortgage rate to 9.75 percent.
The previous fixed rates were 9.95 percent for 2-3 years and 10.25 percent for 4-5 years.
Hongkong Bank said that with its one year fixed rate of 9.95 percent and a floating rate of 10.95 percent it had the lowest rates of the local trading banks.
The move was designed to re-establish Hongkong Bank's leading position in the market.
